name: Downtown Dubai
description: Landmark architecture, city-centre apartments and a vibrant setting around Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall and the boulevard.

name: Palm Jumeirah
description: An iconic island community bringing together beachfront villas, waterfront apartments, resort hotels and coastal dining.

name: Dubai Marina
description: Marina views, waterside promenades and high-rise homes in one of Dubai’s most established waterfront neighbourhoods.

name: Business Bay
description: A connected urban district with canal-side apartments, commercial towers and convenient access to Downtown Dubai.

name: Dubai Harbour
description: A maritime destination with waterfront residences, marina facilities and views across Dubai’s coastline.

name: Jumeirah Beach Residence
description: Beachside apartments, outdoor dining and The Walk create an active coastal lifestyle beside Dubai Marina.

name: Jumeirah Lake Towers
description: A well-established mix of residential and commercial towers arranged around lakes, walking paths and neighbourhood cafés.

name: Jumeirah Village Circle
description: A residential neighbourhood with apartments, townhouses, parks and everyday amenities for a balanced city lifestyle.

name: Dubai Sports City
description: Golf-course surroundings, sporting facilities and residential communities bring an active outlook to everyday living.

name: Dubai Islands
description: An emerging island destination with waterfront residences, beach settings and a new perspective on Dubai’s coastline.

name: Dubai Maritime City
description: A waterfront district offering new residential developments and a coastal setting between Port Rashid and Dubai’s urban centre.

name: Meydan Horizon
description: A developing residential destination in the wider Meydan area, bringing contemporary homes and planned community spaces together.

name: Arabian Ranches
description: An established villa community with landscaped surroundings, neighbourhood facilities and a relaxed residential character.

name: DAMAC Hills
description: Apartments and villas set around golf-course landscapes, parks and a range of outdoor leisure facilities.

name: Mohammed Bin Rashid City
description: A broad residential district combining villa neighbourhoods, contemporary apartments and connected destinations close to central Dubai.

name: Deira
description: A long-established Dubai district known for its creek-side heritage, traditional markets and busy commercial neighbourhoods.
